gaps.sentence: The report was highly ___ (CRITICISE) of the ministry.
gaps.explanation: 'Be critical of' — adjective; 'criticism' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: The delays have made the project far more ___ (COST) than planned.
gaps.explanation: 'Far more costly' — the comparative adjective is needed after 'more'.

gaps.sentence: ___ (FORTUNE), the package had already been delivered.
gaps.explanation: The sentence adverb is 'Fortunately' — luckily for us.
'Studying management' — the field is called management.
'Championship victory' — the title/contest, not the person.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (OWN) of the car park charges by the hour.
gaps.explanation: 'The owner' — the person who owns it; 'ownership' is the state.

gaps.sentence: The law was introduced to stop ___ (CHEAT) by companies.
The castle is ___ (SIGHT) for miles in every direction.
gaps.explanation: 'Be visible' = can be seen; 'visibility' is the noun for how far you can see.
